import unittest
from collections import UserDict

from solution import WorkMessage


class WorkMessageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_valid_job_and_reply(self):
        job = WorkMessage("job", {"id": "j1", "priority": 0, "tags": ["one", "two"]})
        reply = WorkMessage("reply", UserDict({"id": "j1", "accepted": False}))
        self.assertEqual(job.kind, "job")
        self.assertEqual(job.fields, {"id": "j1", "priority": 0, "tags": ["one", "two"]})
        self.assertEqual(reply.fields, {"id": "j1", "accepted": False})
        self.assertTrue(job.is_consistent())
        self.assertTrue(reply.is_consistent())

    def test_constructor_and_property_are_defensive_copies(self):
        tags = ["stable"]
        supplied = {"id": "j", "priority": 9, "tags": tags}
        message = WorkMessage("job", supplied)
        tags.append("later")
        supplied["id"] = "changed"
        exposed = message.fields
        exposed["tags"].append("external")
        exposed["id"] = "external"
        self.assertEqual(message.fields, {"id": "j", "priority": 9, "tags": ["stable"]})
        self.assertIsNot(message.fields, message.fields)

    def test_properties_are_read_only(self):
        message = WorkMessage("reply", {"id": "r", "accepted": True})
        with self.assertRaises((AttributeError, TypeError)):
            message.kind = "job"
        with self.assertRaises((AttributeError, TypeError)):
            message.fields = {}

    def test_invalid_kinds_and_keys_raise_value_error(self):
        for kind in ("", "other", None, 1):
            with self.subTest(kind=kind), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                WorkMessage(kind, {"id": "x", "accepted": True})
        invalid_fields = [
            {"id": "x", "priority": 1},
            {"id": "x", "priority": 1, "tags": [], "extra": 2},
            {"id": "x", "accepted": True, "tags": []},
        ]
        for fields in invalid_fields:
            with self.subTest(fields=fields), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                WorkMessage("job", fields)

    def test_malformed_field_types_raise_type_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            WorkMessage("job", [])
        cases = [
            ("job", {"id": 1, "priority": 1, "tags": []}),
            ("job", {"id": "x", "priority": True, "tags": []}),
            ("job", {"id": "x", "priority": 1.0, "tags": []}),
            ("job", {"id": "x", "priority": 1, "tags": ()}),
            ("job", {"id": "x", "priority": 1, "tags": [1]}),
            ("reply", {"id": "x", "accepted": 1}),
        ]
        for kind, fields in cases:
            with self.subTest(kind=kind, fields=fields), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                WorkMessage(kind, fields)

    def test_invalid_field_values_raise_value_error(self):
        cases = [
            ("job", {"id": "", "priority": 1, "tags": []}),
            ("job", {"id": "x", "priority": -1, "tags": []}),
            ("job", {"id": "x", "priority": 10, "tags": []}),
            ("job", {"id": "x", "priority": 1, "tags": [""]}),
            ("job", {"id": "x", "priority": 1, "tags": ["a", "a"]}),
            ("reply", {"id": "", "accepted": True}),
        ]
        for kind, fields in cases:
            with self.subTest(kind=kind, fields=fields), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                WorkMessage(kind, fields)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
